description: Zero-PR data.json produces the documented empty-state line and skips the HTML artifact entirely.
rubric: PASS only if the reply's substantive content is the documented empty-state line telling the user there are no open PRs in privacy-com, and stops there — no attempt to render, describe, or offer an HTML artifact for zero PRs, and no per-PR summary content (since there are no PRs). FAIL if the reply proceeds as though PRs exist, attempts an HTML artifact, or omits stating that there are no open PRs.
